title: Kissed Smoky Syrian Pork Back Ribs Grill
description: Funky, chewy, and romantic, these Syrian-inspired pork back ribs are perfect for a special occasion. The smoky flavor from the binchotan charcoal will leave you and your loved ones wanting more.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: acidity to cut through the richness

instructions: Preheat the grill to 275°F (135°C) and prepare the binchotan charcoal according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix the Middle Eastern spice blend, honey, lemon juice, and garlic to create the rub for the ribs.
Apply the rub evenly to the pork back ribs, making sure to coat all surfaces.
Place the ribs on the grill, bone side down, and close the lid.
Cook for 2 hours, or until the ribs are tender and the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Brush the ribs with olive oil and flip them over, bone side up.
Continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until the ribs are nicely caramelized.
Remove the ribs from the grill and garnish with fresh parsley.
Let the ribs rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
